cohort: Two cases of low-risk pregnancy where the fetus was diagnosed with grade II GM-IVH via prenatal ultrasound and MRI after a normal second-trimester anomaly scan.
finding: Fetal GM-IVH can be accurately identified and categorized by antenatal sonography, and outcomes are poorer for fetuses affected by higher-grade intraventricular and parenchymal hemorrhages.
mod_finding: Patients with diagnosed GM-IVH were delivered by cesarean section as recommended.
